effect_description_eng:
[Opponent's Turn] While you have another Digimon or Tamer with the [Xros Heart] trait in play, this Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.).
[On Deletion] ＜Save＞ (You may place this card under one of your Tamers.)
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has [Shoutmon] in its name, it gains ＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.).
